nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: Nothing to see here, sir. Move along. This is police business.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: That woman. I know her. She — she is my wife.

nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: I'm sorry for your loss. But there's nothing to be done tonight. Another Ripper killing. We'll file a report in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: Another— no. This isn't the Ripper. Something is wrong. The way she— it doesn't match.

nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: I understand you're in shock, sir. Go home. Be with your children. Let us do our work.

choices.text: This is NOT the Ripper. I know every detail of those killings — I set the type.
Get your hands off me. You're closing this before it's begun.

nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: There's a good man. I'll send word when we know more.
nodes.journal_entry: Rowe closed the case on the spot. They aren't looking for anyone.

nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: You set type. I police the streets. Good night, Mr Hale.
nodes.journal_entry: The detail that doesn't fit: I need to look at this again, when they're gone.

nodes.speaker: Constable Rowe
nodes.text: Sir, if you don't step back I will remove you from this alley by force. Your choice.
nodes.journal_entry: Rowe. He moved too fast to close this. Why?
